role.documentation: Information by type of debt instrument, including, but not limited to, draws against credit facilities.

role.label: Long-Term Debt, Gross
role.documentation: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

role.terseLabel: Long-term debt excluding finance lease obligations
role.label: Debt Instrument Carrying Amount Excluding Finance Lease Obligations
role.documentation: It represents the amount of debt excluding finance lease obligations.

role.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
role.documentation: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

role.label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
role.documentation: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

role.label: Debt Instrument [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Debt Instrument, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The name for the particular debt instrument or borrowing that distinguishes it from other debt instruments or borrowings, including draws against credit facilities.

role.label: Schedule of Long-Term Debt Instruments [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about long-term debt instrument or arrangement.

role.label: Debt Instrument, Term
role.documentation: Period of time between issuance and maturity of debt instrument, in PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
role.documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

role.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

role.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
role.documentation: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

role.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Default Provision On Credit Facility
role.documentation: The limit on the amount of a default on other indebtedness which would trigger a default under the reporting entity's credit facility.

role.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

role.verboseLabel: Less: net unamortized debt issuance costs
role.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

role.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

role.label: Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
role.documentation: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the unamortized adjustment to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item made under an effective interest rate fair value hedge that is amortized upon discontinuation of the interest rate fair value hedge.

role.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

role.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

role.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

role.label: Deferred Revenue, Current
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

role.label: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Deferred setup costs [Member]
role.documentation: Deferred set up costs.

role.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Hedging Transactions
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from hedging transactions.

role.label: Deferred Tax Asset, In-Process Research and Development
role.documentation: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Leases
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from leases.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
role.documentation: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Tax effect of foreign and domestic loss carryforwards
role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards and Tax Credit Carryforwards
role.documentation: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards and Tax Credit Carryforwards

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
role.documentation: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

role.terseLabel: Foreign and domestic tax credit carryforwards
role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
role.documentation: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Postretirement Benefits
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-Based Compensation Cost
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

role.terseLabel: Bad debt, inventory and warranty reserves
role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross [Abstract]
Deferred Tax Liabilities, G I L T I Deferred Taxes
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income ("GILTI").

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Hedging Transactions
role.documentation: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Hedging Transactions

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Tax Deferred Expense Compensation and Benefits Pension and Postretirement Benefits
role.documentation: The amount as of the balance sheet date of the estimated future tax effects attributable to pension and postretirement benefits expensed for tax purposes but capitalized in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles, which will reverse in future periods when amortization of such capitalized costs cannot be deducted for tax purposes.

role.verboseLabel: Deferred tax liability for undistributed foreign earnings not indefinitely reinvested
role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

role.totalLabel: Total loss recognized in accumulated other comprehensive income/(loss)
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

role.negatedPeriodStartLabel: Net loss at beginning of period
role.negatedPeriodEndLabel: Net loss at end of period
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Gain (Loss), before Tax
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

role.periodStartLabel: Prior service costs/(credits) at beginning of period
role.periodEndLabel: Prior service costs/(credits) at end of period
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Transition Asset (Obligation), before Tax
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

role.terseLabel: Return on assets sold during the year
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Sold
role.documentation: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets sold.

role.terseLabel: Return on assets held at end of year
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Still Held
role.documentation: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets still held.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
role.documentation: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position
role.documentation: Amount of asset (liability), recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

role.terseLabel: Net funded status recognized in the Consolidated Balance Sheet
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position [Abstract]
Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
role.documentation: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Allocations [Abstract]

role.negatedTerseLabel: Benefit plan assets transferred from plan
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumed Health Care Cost Trend Rates [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
role.documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
role.documentation: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
role.documentation: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Discount Rate
role.documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Discount Rate Post Remeasurement Adjustment
role.documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan post remeasurement adjustment.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Discount Rate Pre Remeasurement Adjustment
role.documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan prior to remeasurement adjustment.

role.terseLabel: Expected long-term returns on plan assets
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-Term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
role.documentation: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

role.terseLabel: Expected long-term returns on plan assets, post-remeasurement adjustment
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Expected Long Term Return On Assets Post Remeasurement Adjustment
role.documentation: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan, post remeasurement adjustment.

role.terseLabel: Expected long-term returns on plan assets, pre-remeasurement adjustment
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Expected Long Term Return On Assets Pre Remeasurement Adjustment
role.documentation: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan, prior to remeasurement adjustment.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Rate of Compensation Increase
role.documentation: Weighted average rate of compensation increase used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
role.documentation: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Weighted Average Interest Crediting Rate Post Remeasurement Adjustment
role.documentation: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate, post remeasurement adjustment.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost Weighted Average Interest Crediting Rate Pre Remeasurement Adjustment
role.documentation: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate, prior to remeasurement adjustment.

role.periodStartLabel: Benefit obligation, balance at beginning of period
role.periodEndLabel: Benefit obligation, balance at end of period
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Benefits Paid
role.documentation: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Contributions by Plan Participant
role.documentation: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increase benefit obligation.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Benefit plan obligations transferred from plan
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) For Transfer To (From) Plan
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) For Transfer To (From) Plan

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Business Combinations and Acquisitions Net of Divestitures Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: The amount of increase or decrease in the benefit obligation attributed to business combinations, net of divestitures.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Business Combinations and Acquisitions Net of Divestitures Fair Value Plan Assets
role.documentation: The amount of increase or decrease in the fair value of plan assets attributed to business combinations, net of divestitures.

role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Category [Axis]
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Category [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by defined benefit plan asset investment.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Benefit Obligation [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Fair Value of Plan Assets [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.terseLabel: Commitments for future investments in private markets
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Commitments for Future Investments
role.documentation: Amount of commitments for future investments in private markets to be made over a number of years.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Company Monthly Contributions, Percent
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Company Monthly Contributions to Retirement Benefit Accounts (RBA) Based on Employee Eligible Compensation, Percent

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
role.documentation: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Contributions By Employer, Noncash
role.documentation: Noncash contributions made by the employer during the period to a defined benefit plan. These contributions may be in the form of securities.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Derivative [Member]
role.documentation: Financial instrument or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both; can be settled net by means outside contract or delivery of asset; and with minimal or no initial net investment, in which defined benefit plan asset is invested.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Direct Benefits Paid
role.documentation: The amount of benefits directly paid.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Disclosure [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Equity Securities [Member]
role.documentation: Security representing ownership in corporation or other legal entity for which ownership is represented by share of stock, in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, common stock, preferred stock, convertible security, stock right and stock warrant.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, after Year Five for Next Five Years
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Three
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Two
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.verboseLabel: Estimated cash contributions to the defined benefit plans in next fiscal year
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year
role.documentation: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
role.documentation: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

role.periodStartLabel: Fair value of plan assets, balance at beginning of period
role.periodEndLabel: Fair value of plan assets, balance at end of period
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded Percentage
role.documentation: Percentage of plan assets to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
role.documentation: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Health care cost trend rate assumed for next fiscal year
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed, Next Fiscal Year
role.documentation: Assumed rate, for next fiscal year, based on annual change in cost of health care cost benefits used to measure expected cost of benefits covered by defined benefit postretirement plan. Factors include, but are not limited to, estimate of health care inflation, change in health care utilization or delivery pattern, technological advances, and change in health status of participant. Excludes factors for change in composition of plan population by age and dependency status.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Percent, Period One
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Percent, Period One

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Percent, Period Two
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Percent, Period Two

role.terseLabel: Investments measured at net asset value using the NAV practical expedient
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Investments Measured at Net Asset Value [Member]
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Investments Measured at Net Asset Value

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Multi-Employer Defined Benefit Plan Costs
role.documentation: Amount of cost for multi-employer defined benefit plans.

role.totalLabel: Total net periodic pension / nonpension (income)/cost of defined benefit plans
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
role.documentation: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

role.verboseLabel: Components of net periodic (income)/cost of the retirement-related benefit plans
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Other Cost (Credit)
role.documentation: Amount of defined benefit plan cost (credit), classified as other.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Other [Member]
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Other

role.terseLabel: Plans with PBO in excess of plan assets, Plan Assets
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
role.documentation: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

role.terseLabel: Plans with PBO in excess of plan assets, Benefit Obligation
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension and Non-Pension Plans with Accumulated Benefit Obligations in Excess of Plan Assets
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Plans with ABO in excess of plan assets, Benefit Obligation
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

role.terseLabel: Plans with ABO in excess of plan assets, Plan Assets
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
role.documentation: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Period of Ultimate Trend Rate
role.documentation: Period for which ultimate health care cost trend rate is expected to be applicable.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Amendments Curtailments and Settlements
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) in benefit obligation resulting from plan amendments, curtailments, settlements and other changes not separately identified.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Amendments Curtailments and Settlements Changes in Plan Assets
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) in plan assets resulting from plan amendments, curtailments, settlements and other changes not separately identified.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Benefits Paid
role.documentation: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Plan Participant
role.documentation: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increases plan assets.

role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Fair Value by Hierarchy and NAV [Extensible Enumeration]
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Fair Value by Hierarchy and NAV [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy and fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient, of defined benefit plan asset.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) plan assets of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Target Allocation, Percentage
role.documentation: Percentage of target investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

role.verboseLabel: Plans with assets in excess of PBO, Benefit Obligation
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Plans with Plan Assets in Excess of Projected Benefit Obligation, Aggregate Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: If aggregate disclosures are presented, the aggregate benefit obligation for plans with plan assets in excess of the projected benefit obligation as of the measurement date of each statement of financial position presented.

role.verboseLabel: Plans with assets in excess of PBO, Plan Assets

role.documentation: If aggregate disclosures are presented, the aggregate fair value of plan assets for plans with plan assets in excess of the projected benefit obligation as of the measurement date of each statement of financial position presented.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement
role.documentation: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase (decrease) in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase, sale and settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

role.label: Employee Benefit Plan, Real Estate [Member]
role.documentation: Property composed of building, land, and land improvement; in which employee benefit plan asset is invested.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from settlement and curtailment.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Requisite Service Period
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Requisite Service Period

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred into (out of) Level 3
role.documentation: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan, for assets transferred into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy. Includes, but is not limited to, transfer due to change in observability of significant inputs.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate
role.documentation: Ultimate trend rate for health care cost for defined benefit postretirement plan.

role.terseLabel: Weighted-average assumptions used to measure benefit obligations at December 31
role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Weighted Average Assumptions Used in Calculating Benefit Obligation [Abstract]

Postretirement Health Coverage [Member]
role.documentation: Plan designed to provide postretirement health benefits to retiree or beneficiary. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

role.label: Defined Contribution Pension Plan Liabilities, Noncurrent
role.documentation: This represents the noncurrent liability recognized in the balance sheet that is associated with defined contribution plans, specifically the company's excess 401(k) plus plan, an unfunded nonqualified plan

role.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

role.label: Depreciation
role.documentation: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

role.label: Depreciation And Amortization Of Non-Acquired Intangibles
role.documentation: Depreciation And Amortization Of Non-Acquired Intangibles

role.label: Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property and equipment costs, including methods used and estimated useful lives and how impairment of such assets is assessed and recognized.

role.label: Derivative Asset, Gross Asset Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
role.documentation: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

role.terseLabel: Potential reduction in net position of total derivative assets
role.label: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
role.documentation: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset.

role.label: Derivative, Average Remaining Maturity
role.documentation: Average remaining period until maturity of the derivative contract, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Derivative Contract [Domain]
role.documentation: Financial instrument or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Gain (Loss) Recognized in Earnings and Other Comprehensive Income - Amounts Excluded from Effectiveness Testing
role.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Recognized in Earnings
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

role.terseLabel: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) recognized in earnings from excluded component of derivative hedge.

role.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

role.terseLabel: Derivative, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) from derivative.

role.label: Derivative Instrument [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of derivative contract.

role.terseLabel: Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities Disclosure [Abstract]
role.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities Disclosure [Abstract]
Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for derivative instruments and hedging activities including, but not limited to, risk management strategies, non-hedging derivative instruments, assets, liabilities, revenue and expenses, and methodologies and assumptions used in determining the amounts.

role.label: Hedging Relationship [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of hedging relationship.

role.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about the location and amount of derivative instruments and nonderivative instruments designated as hedging instruments reported before netting adjustments, and the amount of gain (loss) on derivative instruments and nonderivative instruments designated and qualified as hedging instruments.

role.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Assets, at Fair Value
role.documentation: Aggregate fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

role.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Liabilities, at Fair Value
role.documentation: Aggregate fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

role.terseLabel: Derivatives not designated as hedging - Assets
role.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset, at Fair Value
role.documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

role.terseLabel: Derivatives not designated as hedging - Liabilities
role.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
role.documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

role.label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

role.label: Derivative Liability, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
role.documentation: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

role.terseLabel: Potential reduction in net position of total derivative liabilities
role.label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
role.documentation: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability.

role.label: Derivative [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
role.documentation: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

role.label: Derivative [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about derivative instrument or group of derivative instruments, including, but not limited to, type of derivative instrument, risk being hedged, notional amount, hedge designation, related hedged item, inception date, and maturity date.

role.label: Derivative, Term of Contract
role.documentation: Period the derivative contract is outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Derivatives, Fair Value [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting, Hedging Derivatives [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for derivatives used in hedging relationships, which may include how gains or losses are recognized and presented in the financial statements, and amortization policies for deferred amounts.

role.label: Derivatives, Offsetting Fair Value Amounts, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for offsetting or not offsetting fair value amounts recognized for derivative instruments against such amounts recognized for the right to reclaim cash collateral (a receivable) or the obligation to return cash collateral (a payable) arising from derivative instruments recognized at fair value.

role.label: Derivatives, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for its derivative instruments and hedging activities.

role.label: Developed Technology Rights [Member]
role.documentation: Rights to developed technology, which can include the right to develop, use, market, sell, or offer for sale products, compounds, or intellectual property.

role.label: Direct Benefit Payments [Member]
role.documentation: Direct Benefit Payments [Member]

role.label: Disaggregation of Revenue [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Disaggregation of Revenue [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about disaggregation of revenue into categories depicting how nature, amount, timing, and uncertainty of revenue and cash flows are affected by economic factor.

role.label: Disaggregation of Revenue [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of disaggregation of revenue into categories depicting how nature, amount, timing, and uncertainty of revenue and cash flows are affected by economic factor.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Abstract]

role.verboseLabel: Discontinued operations provision for/(benefit from) income taxes
role.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
role.documentation: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

role.label: Disposal Group Classification [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by disposal group classification.

role.label: Disposal Group Classification [Domain]
role.documentation: Component or group of components disposed of, including but not limited to, disposal group held-for-sale or disposed of by sale, disposed of by means other than sale, and discontinued operations.

role.terseLabel: Disposal Group, Disposed of by Sale, Not Discontinued Operations
role.label: Disposal Group, Disposed of by Sale, Not Discontinued Operations [Member]
role.documentation: Disposal group that has been sold. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.

role.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consideration
role.documentation: Amount of consideration received or receivable for the disposal of assets and liabilities, including discontinued operation.

role.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Contingent Consideration
role.documentation: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Contingent Consideration

role.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
role.documentation: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

role.terseLabel: Pre-tax gain on sale of business
role.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
role.documentation: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

role.terseLabel: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income that includes gain (loss) recognized on sale or disposal of disposal group. Excludes discontinued operation.

role.label: Disposal Group Name [Domain]
role.documentation: Name of disposal group.

role.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
role.documentation: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true only for a form used as an annual report.

role.label: Document Financial Statement Error Correction [Flag]
role.documentation: Indicates whether any of the financial statement period in the filing include a restatement due to error correction.

role.label: Document Fiscal Period Focus
role.documentation: Fiscal period values are FY, Q1, Q2, and Q3. 1st, 2nd and 3rd quarter 10-Q or 10-QT statements have value Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively, with 10-K, 10-KT or other fiscal year statements having FY.

role.label: Document Fiscal Year Focus
role.documentation: This is focus fiscal year of the document report in YYYY format. For a 2006 annual report, which may also provide financial information from prior periods, fiscal 2006 should be given as the fiscal year focus. Example: 2006.

role.label: Document Information [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Document Information [Table]
role.documentation: Container to support the formal attachment of each official or unofficial, public or private document as part of a submission package.

role.label: Document Period End Date
role.documentation: For the EDGAR submission types of Form 8-K: the date of the report, the date of the earliest event reported; for the EDGAR submission types of Form N-1A: the filing date; for all other submission types: the end of the reporting or transition period. The format of the date is YYYY-MM-DD.

role.label: Document Transition Report
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true only for a form used as a transition report.

role.label: Document Type
role.documentation: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

role.label: Documents Incorporated by Reference [Text Block]
role.documentation: Documents incorporated by reference.

role.documentation: Designated federal jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax in country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, national jurisdiction for non-U.S. jurisdiction.

role.label: Domestic Plan [Member]
role.documentation: Location of employer sponsoring plan, designed to provide retirement benefits, determined as principal place of business. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

role.label: Earnings Per Share [Abstract]
Earnings Per Share, Basic
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic [Abstract]
Earnings Per Share, Diluted
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Earnings Per Share of Common Stock
role.label: Earnings Per Share, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for computing basic and diluted earnings or loss per share for each class of common stock and participating security. Addresses all significant policy factors, including any antidilutive items that have been excluded from the computation and takes into account stock dividends, splits and reverse splits that occur after the balance sheet date of the latest reporting period but before the issuance of the financial statements.

role.label: Earnings Per Share [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for earnings per share.

role.terseLabel: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
role.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

role.verboseLabel: Effective income tax rate reconciliation, additional disclosures
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.terseLabel: Effect of changes in tax laws or rates enacted in the current period
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border, Other, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border Tax Effect, Amount [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Cross-Border Tax Effect, Percent [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Current Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Amount
role.documentation: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Current Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Amount

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Current Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Percent
role.documentation: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Current Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Percent

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deferred Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Amount
role.documentation: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deferred Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Amount

role.documentation: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deferred Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Percent

role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable primarily to research tax credit(s) and deductions for qualified domestic production activity.

role.terseLabel: Domestic incentives, portion related to one-time pension settlement charge
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Domestic Incentives Percentage Point Impact Related To One Time Pension Settlement Charge
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable primarily to research tax credit(s) and deductions for qualified domestic production activity. This percentage relates to a one-time pension settlement charge.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

role.terseLabel: Tax differential on foreign income, portion related to one-time pension settlement charge
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential Percentage Point Impact Related To One Time Pension Settlement Charge
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile. This is the percentage of the total related to a one-time pension settlement charge.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Line Items]
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.terseLabel: Other, portion related to one-time pension settlement charge
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Other Adjustments Percentage Point Impact Related To One Time Pension Settlement Charge
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments. Percentage related to one-time pension settlement charge.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: State and Local income taxes, net of federal income tax effect
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

role.terseLabel: State and local, portion related to one-time pension settlement charge
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation State And Local Income Taxes Percentage Point Impact Related To One Time Pension Settlement Charge
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit). Percentage relates to one-time pension settlement charge.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of contributions and direct benefit payments

role.terseLabel: Pre-tax cost for all retirement-related plans

role.terseLabel: Components of deferred tax assets and liabilities

role.label: Schedule of Defined Benefit Plans Disclosures [Table Text Block]

role.terseLabel: Effect of derivative instruments in the Consolidated Income Statement

role.terseLabel: Computation of basic and diluted earnings/(loss) per share

role.terseLabel: Reconciliation of the beginning and ending balances of Level 3 assets
role.label: Schedule of Effect of Significant Unobservable Inputs, Changes in Plan Assets [Table Text Block]

role.label: Schedule of Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the reconciliation using percentage or dollar amounts of the reported amount of income tax expense attributable to continuing operations for the year to the amount of income tax expense that would result from applying domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount [Table]

role.terseLabel: Stock-based compensation cost included in income from continuing operations

role.terseLabel: Segment Reporting, Revenue from External Customer, Product and Service [Table]

role.terseLabel: Revenue by classes of similar products or services
role.label: Revenue from External Customers by Products and Services [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of entity-wide revenues from external customers for each product or service or each group of similar products or services if the information is not provided as part of the reportable operating segment information.

role.terseLabel: Total expected benefit payments, pension benefit plans and nonpension postretirement plans
role.label: Schedule of Expected Benefit Payments [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of benefits expected to be paid by pension plans and/or other employee benefit plans in each of the next five fiscal years and in the aggregate for the five fiscal years thereafter.

role.label: Schedule of Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis [Table Text Block]

The disclosures contemplated herein include the fair value measurements at the reporting date by the level within the fair value hierarchy in which the fair value measurements in their entirety fall, segregating fair value measurements using quoted prices in active markets for identical assets (Level 1), significant other observable inputs (Level 2), and significant unobservable inputs (Level 3).

role.terseLabel: Amounts related to cumulative basis adjustments for fair value hedges
role.label: Schedule of Fair Value Hedging Instruments, Statements of Financial Performance and Financial Position, Location [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure for fair value hedging instruments of (a) the location and amount of gains and losses reported in the statement of financial performance and (b) the location and fair value amounts of the instruments reported in the statement of financial position.

role.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Quality Indicator [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about credit quality indicator for financing receivable.

role.label: Financing Receivable, Past Due [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about aging analysis for financing receivable.

role.label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived [Table]

role.terseLabel: Intangible asset balances by major asset class
role.label: Schedule of Finite-Lived Intangible Assets [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life, by either major class or business segment.

role.label: Goodwill [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about goodwill, including, but not limited to, change from acquisition, sale, impairment, and other reason.

role.terseLabel: Changes in goodwill balances by reportable segment
role.label: Schedule of Goodwill [Table Text Block]

role.label: Schedule Of Interest On Debt [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: This table discloses the total interest paid and accrued on the debt instruments.

role.label: Schedule of Inventory, Current [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held for future sale or to be used in manufacturing, servicing or production process.

role.terseLabel: Pre-swap annual contractual obligations of long-term debt outstanding
role.label: Schedule of Maturities of Long-Term Debt [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of maturity and sinking fund requirement for long-term debt.

role.terseLabel: Components of net periodic (income)/cost of the company's retirement-related benefit plans
role.label: Schedule of Net Benefit Costs [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of net benefit costs for pension plans and/or other employee benefit plans including service cost, interest cost, expected return on plan assets, gain (loss), prior service cost or credit, transition asset or obligation, and gain (loss) recognized due to settlements or curtailments.

role.verboseLabel: Summary of the total PBO for defined benefit plans, APBO for nonpension postretirement benefit plans, fair value of plan assets and associated funded status

role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of net funded status of pension plans and/or other employee benefit plans.

role.terseLabel: Summary of performance share units activity

role.documentation: Schedule Of Other Income And Expense

role.label: Schedule of Post-Swap Long-Term Debt [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of long-debt instruments or arrangements, including the current and noncurrent portion, after giving effect to the impact of interest rate swaps.

role.label: Schedule of Product Warranty Liability [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the changes in the guarantor's aggregate product warranty liability, including the beginning balance of the aggregate product warranty liability, the aggregate reductions in that liability for payments made (in cash or in kind) under the warranty, the aggregate changes in the liability for accruals related to product warranties issued during the reporting period, the aggregate changes in the liability for accruals related to preexisting warranties (including adjustments related to changes in estimates), and the ending balance of the aggregate product warranty liability.

role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, balances by class of assets, depreciation and depletion expense and method used, including composite depreciation, and accumulated deprecation.

role.label: Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired and Liability Assumed [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of asset acquired and liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Retirement Related Benefit Plans Disclosures [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Retirement Related Benefit Plans Disclosures [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosures about retirement-related benefit plans including defined benefit pension plans, defined contribution pension plans and non-pension postretirement plans.

role.label: Schedule of Revenue from External Customers and Long-Lived Assets, by Geographical Areas [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of information concerning material long-lived assets (excluding financial instruments, customer relationships with financial institutions, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred taxes assets) located in identified geographic areas and/or the amount of revenue from external customers attributed to that country from which revenue is material. An entity may also provide subtotals of geographic information about groups of countries.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Revenues from External Customers and Long-Lived Assets [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Revenues from External Customers and Long-Lived Assets [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about revenue from external customer and long-lived asset by geographical area. role.label: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about profit (loss) and total assets by reportable segment.

role.label: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the profit or loss and total assets for each reportable segment. An entity discloses certain information on each reportable segment if the amounts (a) are included in the measure of segment profit or loss reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) are otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in that measure of segment profit or loss.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award [Table]

role.documentation: Disclosure of information about share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Summary of restricted stock units activity

role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the number and weighted-average grant date fair value for restricted stock units that were outstanding at the beginning and end of the year, and the number of restricted stock units that were granted, vested, or forfeited during the year.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure for stock option plans. Includes, but is not limited to, outstanding awards at beginning and end of year, grants, exercises, forfeitures, and weighted-average grant date fair value.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of weighted-average assumptions used for estimation of fair value of stock options
role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Payment Award, Stock Options, Valuation Assumptions [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the significant assumptions used during the year to estimate the fair value of stock options, including, but not limited to: (a) expected term of share options and similar instruments, (b) expected volatility of the entity's shares, (c) expected dividends, (d) risk-free rate(s), and (e) discount for post-vesting restrictions.

role.label: Stock, Class of Stock [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about stock by class. Includes, but is not limited to, common, convertible, and preferred stocks.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of supplemental information relating to the cash flows arising from lease transactions
role.label: Schedule of Supplemental Information Relating to Cash Flows Arising from Lease Transactions [Table Text Block]
